title: Saṃyojanam
text: 2. Sace vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam puccheyyuṃ || || Kim atthi yam āvuso samaṇe Gotame brahmacariyam vussatī ti || evam puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesam añña- parib- evam vyākareyyatha || || Saṃyojanapahānatthaṃ kho āvuso Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī ti || la ||
